title: Airport Bingo
instructions: Spot a suitcase, a plane, a window, a sign, a backpack and a trolley. Mark each square on the printable. Play together from your seat; stay with your grown-up.

title: Restaurant I Spy
instructions: Choose something everyone can see. Say “I spy something…” and give its colour or shape. Take turns guessing, then let the next person choose. Keep the game at your table.

title: My Little Travel Journal
instructions: Draw where you went, something you tasted and your favourite discovery. Write a sentence or ask a grown-up to take dictation. Add one page each day.

title: Nature Color Hunt
instructions: Choose three colours and find something in each colour. Look, point or photograph your finds rather than picking them. Swap colours and try again. For younger children, find one colour together.

title: DIY Paper Puppets
instructions: Fold a strip of scrap paper into a standing zigzag character. Draw a face and decorate it. Make two characters, choose names and invent a tiny adventure. A grown-up handles any cutting.

title: Beach Treasure Collection
instructions: Make a collection of discoveries by spotting a smooth stone, a pattern, seaweed and three colours. Point, draw or photograph them. Leave shells, wildlife and natural objects where they belong; stay away from the water’s edge with your grown-up.

title: Postcards From My Trip
instructions: Draw one little moment from today on the postcard front. On the back, write or dictate a message to someone you miss. Save it in your notebook or send it after your trip.

title: Rainy Day Mini Theater
instructions: Turn a small empty box on its side for a stage, or fold paper into a backdrop. Draw two characters and a setting. Tell a three-scene story: a surprise, a problem and a happy ending. Let everyone take a turn.
